what: Hovering a card makes it pop to 1.13x in .2s easeOutCubic, then settle to 1.1x with a wobble on a .8s spring (Velocity spring curve 1 − cos(4.5πp)·e^(−6p)), while a second stacked photo (smiling shot) turns on in .08s. On release it presses to .985x for .15s then returns to 1x on a .8s spring, and the second photo turns off in .15s. Not attached on devices without hover

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photo cell (optional child) — holds the second photo

from.where: recruit.html .rc-list li (three teacher interview cards — original .interview-list li mouseenter and mouseleave Velocity)
